answer_1.quote: In this paper, we argue that figure captioning in scientific documents can be more effectively tackled as a text‑summarization task …

answer_2.quote: We used F1 of ROUGE‑1, ROUGE‑2, ROUGE‑L, MoverScore and BERTScore for automatic evaluation …

answer_4.quote: Three Ph.D. students with NLP backgrounds (who are not coauthors) were recruited as human judges … The judges were asked to rank the captions based on how strongly they agreed with this statement: "When I read the paper, this caption can help me understand the message that the figure tries to convey."
answer_4.guideline: Rank captions according to how well they help the reader understand the figure's message (1 = best, 3 = worst).
